text:
mike: RFP follow-up: enterprise bank wants hardened on-prem deployment with zero internet. They asked about install method, upgrade cadence, signing, and pricing for an air-gapped POC.

anya: Quick answers: we offer operator-led installs and an immutable offline bundle. Operator needs cluster access at install time; bundle is a tarball with all images/manifests + SBOM + signatures for zero-egress sites.

lee: For cadence we recommend monthly security patches and quarterly feature releases. For risk-averse customers we can lock to quarterly-only. We can also provide emergency CVE hotfix bundles off-cycle.

sasha: Signing/validation details: every bundle is signed with our org key and includes an SBOM and signing.prov file. For no-egress, verification keys and CRLs are embedded. For limited-egress, we provide an optional check-in stub for revocation checks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: activation-mode: supports single-use per-bundle activation keys and long-lived site tokens. Default for regulated customers: single-use per-bundle keys.

mike: Commercial ask: what's the POC pricing model? Free hosted trial vs paid air-gapped POC?

anya: Hosted POC = free credits. Air-gapped POC = fixed packaging & validation fee (covers signing, SBOM, validation runs). Add-on: expedited patch SLA for an extra fee.

lee: Ops note: delta patches are supported via signed patch bundles but require validation runs. Rollbacks are supported by applying previous signed bundle. We'll include rollback instructions in the bundle README.

mike: Can someone paste the offline install snippet we hand to customers?

lee: Snippet we provide:
```
redwoodctl install --bundle /tmp/redwood-offline.tgz \
  --activation-key REDACTED-KEY \
  --sbom /tmp/sbom.json \
  --verify /tmp/signature.sig
```

anya: Action items: anya to draft pricing lines and POC fee, sasha to attach cert-rotation and SBOM sample, lee to prepare no-egress test matrix. Aim to reply to buyer by EOD.

mike: Thanks team. Flag any legal or signing infra blockers here. :thumbsup:
